title: Controller external-config manifest binding repair: config.toml logical entry, doctor/verify-controller/start verification, fail-closed production dispatch (D-017 Stage 1)
objective: Repair the deployment-safety defect confirmed at 026e7cb: verify_manifest is never called with extra_files on any CLI path, so the external protected config (C:\Program Files\SupervisorConfig\config.toml) is structurally unbindable into manifest verification; start without --manifest silently passes controller_manifest=True; verify-controller has no --config; no CLI command records a manifest; staleness is never checked. Implement the external-config manifest contract: stable logical name config.toml without leaking the absolute private path; a manifest recording command; doctor --manifest --config, verify-controller --manifest --config, and start all verify the external config before provider contact; production dispatch fails closed if the manifest omits config.toml, the config path is missing, the digest differs, or the manifest is stale; model_selection.toml stays excluded; no package duplication, no symlink/hard-link workaround, no protected-config change. Add the nine D-017-R051 regression proofs; regenerate the controller-update runbook from merged source in PowerShell-native form (no CMD carets, no unresolved placeholders).
business_reason: The live controller cannot be safely updated (D-017 Stage 2) while its manifest verification cannot bind the active immutable config; the current runbook would generate a manifest that silently omits the protected config it claims to cover.
inputs: CONTROLLER_UPDATE_RUNBOOK_2026-08-18.md (superseded external runbook; source of the S13 command inventory)

acceptance_scenarios.given: a recorded manifest binding the external protected config under logical name config.toml and an unchanged config file
acceptance_scenarios.when: doctor --manifest --config, verify-controller --manifest --config, and the start verification path run
acceptance_scenarios.then: all three verify the external config against the manifest and pass; the manifest contains no absolute private path

acceptance_scenarios.given: the same manifest and a config file changed by one byte
acceptance_scenarios.then: each fails closed with a digest mismatch naming the logical entry config.toml

acceptance_scenarios.given: the same manifest and a missing config path
acceptance_scenarios.then: each fails closed (missing), never treats absence as pass

acceptance_scenarios.given: a manifest that omits the config.toml logical entry

acceptance_scenarios.then: the controller manifest remains valid (model selection stays excluded by design)

acceptance_scenarios.given: any failing manifest/config verification on the start path
acceptance_scenarios.then: no provider call occurs (verified with a fake provider transport)

acceptance_scenarios.given: a stale manifest (recorded controller_version differing from the running CONTROLLER_VERSION)

acceptance_scenarios.then: it contains no CMD caret continuation and no unresolved executable placeholders, and doctor --live remains the only intentional bounded live control-response probe

risks: Supervisor-freeze lane: change must re-establish the M0-T039 suite baseline (>=1165 tests, 0 failures) and cite qualifying evidence in packet + commit message.

Fail-closed additions must not break the existing test-only synthetic-root manifest flows (test_agent_supervisor_phase1/broker); test-only code-manifest behavior may remain where appropriate (D-017-R047).
The A1 supervised start command (D-016 runbook s13) gains --manifest/--config coverage; the regenerated runbook must reflect the merged source exactly, not remembered commands.
supervisor_freeze_qualifying_evidence: AD-093 defect lane (supervisor-freeze rule s2): (a) REPRODUCED DEFECT - at main@026e7cb, verify_manifest is called without extra_files on every CLI path (cli.py:443, cli.py:1551, cli.py:2704-2705), so the external protected config is structurally unbindable into manifest verification and a manifest that correctly recorded a config.toml logical entry would FAIL as 'missing'; start without --manifest sets controller_manifest=True having verified nothing (cli.py:2704-2705, _dispatch_inputs_missing cli.py:2228-2237); verify-controller has no --config input (cli.py:3023-3028); no CLI command records a manifest (write_manifest has no production caller); require_verified has zero production callers. (b) DEMONSTRATED SECURITY RISK - production dispatch can proceed with a manifest that omits the active immutable config entirely, defeating the config-binding guarantee the README claims (README.md:454-456). Evidence file: project-control/reports/M0-T072-defect-evidence.md.
